texts.text_1: While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes
texts.text_2: The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain
texts.text_3: On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface
texts.text_4: On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size
texts.text_5: As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks

args.text: While disassembled, rollers can be set to other modes
The 'fill' modes can help to bridge gaps between pavement and terrain
On 'straight fill', they will place simple columns down to the surface
On 'sloped fill', layers placed further down will increase in size
As opposed to 'clear & pave', neither of these modes will cause the rollers to break existing blocks
